title: Fix 268
no_spec_change_rationale: REQ-records-006 already requires every value Chough writes, front matter included, to pass the leak check; only the checkpoint guard and its tests change.
acceptance_criteria: A token form in a chough checkpoint --file or --design value, such as src/ghp_<token>.txt, refuses the write as refused:leak naming the field (file or design) and the kind token, never echoing the value, with every file unchanged; with --redact the stored path holds <redacted:token> and the command says it redacted. A file or design path that holds no leak is saved as before.

answers.constraints: The specs/cli/cli.3md lesson on native tasks applies: human gates are listed as plain text in tasks.md, not as checkboxes, and a delta is frozen at approval (this change has none). No other lesson or principle constrains it.
